description: Single source of truth for plans, items, and progress. Narrative documents cite this file rather than restating it. Validated by scripts/roadmap.py: every evidence reference is resolved against the repository, so an item cannot claim completion by asserting it. Rendered to docs/ROADMAP.md.

plans.title: Convergence residuals, Metal 4 study, and Stage 4
plans.goal: Close the open contract-phase residuals, work through the phone-gated evidence battery, and take Stage 4 as revised by the Metal 4 tensor feasibility study. Interleaved by cost; no item implies a release.

plans.title: Delivery instruction quality and Qwen3-TTS prompting
plans.goal: Establish from primary sources how Qwen3-TTS is meant to be prompted, then settle by measurement whether the shipped delivery-preset copy is the reason takes are reported as not reading like the requested emotion. No preset copy changes without evidence.

plans.title: Documentation governance and staleness control
plans.goal: Make documentation state machine-checkable: pin historical records against accidental modification, derive facts from code so prose cannot silently contradict them, and give agents a queryable index instead of a directory to glob.

items.title: Stage 4 mlx pin bump to the newest lockstep pair
items.gate: Same-day A/B on the canonical matrix; keep only on a non-regression.

items.title: P1b static-shape talker compile
items.reason: Confirmed null on 0.31.6: no measurable effect against the pre-registered gate. Recorded as a do-NOT so it is not retried without a new premise.

items.title: Gate 2 — Candidate A fused code-predictor kernel
items.reason: Withdrawn 2026-08-01 at Gate 0; the premise did not survive its own falsifiability rail.

items.title: Long-form text-context carryover, text first
items.gate: Planner-only change proved on text before any acoustic carryover is attempted.

items.title: Phone-gated evidence battery remainder
items.gate: One sitting with the phone unlocked and Auto-Lock Never; iOS control lanes re-run against the current artifacts.

items.title: MOS-proxy advisory column (UTMOSv2)
items.unparkWhen: Only opportunistically, and only as a dev-lane advisory column. It must never become a gate or a publication input.

items.title: Sourced Qwen3-TTS prompting guide with per-claim provenance
items.gate: Every substantive claim labelled OFFICIAL / RESEARCH / MEASURED-HERE / COMMUNITY / UNVERIFIED, and the repo's unsourced canon adjudicated item by item.

items.title: Deterministic delivery-instruction contract gate
items.gate: Fails on append parity across a preset's tiers and on repeated intensifiers; reports direction conflicts against an acknowledgement file so no blind copy edit is forced.

items.title: Short-versus-long instruction A/B
items.gate: Same preset and seeds: official-style short form against the shipped long form. Paired Wilcoxon with BH correction over the delivery matrix.

items.title: English diction append: does it earn its place
items.gate: Delivery matrix with QWENVOICE_ENGLISH_DICTION_REINFORCEMENT=off against the shipped default.

items.title: Voice Design merge template versus plain concatenation
items.gate: The repo-invented 'Voice character: X. Delivery: Y.' framing against plain concatenation and against identity-first ordering with a closing quality anchor.

items.title: Angry pitch-axis contradiction
items.gate: Measure which pitch direction actually reads as angry, then correct whichever of the copy or the expectation lost. The expectation is not automatically the authority.

items.title: Per-file documentation metadata with derived-fact scanning
items.gate: Catches the 2026-08-01 stale tier count, which a git co-change check provably would not; pinned bodies fail the gate on accidental modification.

items.title: Phase 1 — pin every historical document
items.gate: docs/research, docs/audits/archive, and docs/releases sealed by body digest.

items.title: Phase 2 — reclassify the nine misfiled point-in-time reports
items.gate: Every dated report under docs/reference carries historical or superseded status, following the backend-optimization-research-report precedent.

items.title: Phase 3 — source bindings on active documents
items.gate: Annotated incrementally as documents are touched; a binding invented in bulk without reading the document is worse than none.

items.title: Single-source-of-truth roadmap system
items.gate: Multiple concurrent plans; every evidence reference resolved against the repository; staleness surfaced automatically.

items.title: Security workflow starvation on main
items.gate: CodeQL runs to completion on main instead of being cancelled by the next push; branches still supersede.
